rubric: A fact passes only if its substantive value, party direction and material conditions are faithfully represented with source support. An unanswerable fact passes only if the missing information is explicitly unresolved or escalated; silence alone is not a pass. Numeric accuracy includes currency. Count all material false extra assertions against their field. This provisional key covers identified substantive obligations in eight fields; completeness itself awaits independent review. No statement of legal enforceability is evaluated.
